header.name: Robot going for a stroll V11
header.description: Traced from the drawing: each part follows its stroke in Quick Detail "Robot Sketch 2". Five arms from the body (the hinged left arm, the down-left arm, the right arm, the top-left arm and the top arm), two legs, the round body and head as drawn (the head sits to one side), the spiky ears and crest, the antenna and the very long tail. The walk is the Robot Path 2 walk; the arms and legs swing from their roots. Path from Quick Detail "Robot Path 2" (fd1878e1-ac12-4355-afee-3ebeeb07d4d9).
